_comment: Illustrative ADR-BCP-026/027 shapes for the real, unincorporated ZuriBeans on the v2 Organisation-first path. ZuriBeans is a NOT_INCORPORATED operating business (contracts/legal-entity/registry.yaml): it is its own Organisation and its own Tenant, with no LegalEntityProfile, no jurisdiction of incorporation and no registration identifier. Nabhold Group Africa is only the proposed responsible legal actor: the mandate below is PENDING, carries no approval and resolves to nothing (NO_APPLICABLE_MANDATE) until an independent human checker approves a role-, activity- and market-scoped mandate and the separate activation gate permits it. A mandate, a corporate relationship or a registry entry is not an operating mandate, INTERNAL eligibility, tenant access or proof of incorporation. Ids are readable illustrations: runtime ids are Control Plane-minted, and the CP-produced records (tenant_primary_organisation) show a shape, not an event that has happened. The v1 equivalents cannot carry this business (the v1 SUBMITTED application requires a registration identifier); see admission/v1/examples/client-application-lifecycle.json for the fictional synthetic applicant.
